verses.text: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I speak the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

segments.text: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter;
I speak the things which I have made touching the king:
My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

segments.text: Thou art fairer than the children of men;
Grace is poured into thy lips:
Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

verses.text: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.

segments.text: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one,
Thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.text: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously, Because of truth and meekness and righteousness: And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

segments.text: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously,

and
righteousness:

verses.text: Thine arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under thee; They are in the heart of the king’s enemies.

segments.text: Thine arrows are sharp;

in the heart of the king’s enemies.

verses.text: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

segments.text: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever:

verses.text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness: Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

segments.text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness:
Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee

verses.text: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

verses.text: Kings’ daughters are among thy honorable women: At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

segments.text: Kings’ daughters are among thy honorable women:

verses.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house:

segments.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear;
Forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house:

verses.text: So will the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and reverence thou him.

segments.text: So will the king desire thy beauty;
For he is thy lord; and reverence thou him.

verses.text: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; The rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.

segments.text: And the daughter of Tyre
shall be there
with a gift;

verses.text: The king’s daughter within the palace is all glorious: Her clothing is inwrought with gold.

segments.text: The king’s daughter within

verses.text: She shall be led unto the king in broidered work: The virgins her companions that follow her Shall be brought unto thee.

verses.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: They shall enter into the king’s palace.

segments.text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led:

verses.text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.

segments.text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children,

verses.text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the peoples give thee thanks for ever and ever.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.
